positive_cases.name: get_changes_granted
positive_cases.scenario: Replication read right granted to a synthetic principal.

positive_cases.name: get_changes_all_granted
positive_cases.scenario: Extended replication right granted to a synthetic principal.

negative_cases.name: descriptor_change_without_replication_right
negative_cases.scenario: Domain object descriptor updated with an unrelated right.
negative_cases.rationale: The replication right selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: organisational_unit_attribute_change
negative_cases.rationale: The security descriptor attribute selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: descriptor_read
negative_cases.scenario: Domain object security descriptor read during an audit.
negative_cases.rationale: The event identifier selection does not match a read operation.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
